scene: You step off the rickshaw into breezy Windmill Flats.
picture: Flat rooftop tiles run across the bottom. On the far left sits an empty yellow bicycle rickshaw. Left of centre, a closed rusty hatch lies flat. In the centre, the tall mustachioed man stands beside fluttering laundry on a low line. On the right rises a tall wooden windmill with a ladder.
shown: a closed rusty iron hatch set in the floor on the left
a fluttering line of colourful shirts strung low in the centre
a tall wooden windmill with a side ladder on the right
